title: 「be worth + noun ／ V-ing」表達價值

source.file: Sentence Structure 242 - 「be worth + noun _ V-ing」表達價值.pdf

The source filename is numbered 242; it is assigned system ID ss243 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: Subject + be + worth + noun / noun phrase

formulas.formula: Subject + be + worth + noun / noun phrase
Subject + may / might / could + be worth + noun / V-ing

example: The exhibition is worth a visit.

examples.en: The exhibition is worth a visit.
examples.highlight: The exhibition is worth a visit.

examples.en: It is worth checking the details.
examples.highlight: It is worth checking the details.

examples.en: The article is well worth reading.
examples.highlight: The article is well worth reading.

meaning.zh: 表示某件事具有足夠價值、好處、重要性或實用性，值得花費金錢、時間或努力，承受風險，或進行某項行動。

rules.zh: worth 後使用 V-ing，不使用 to + 動詞。
rules.en: Use the -ing form after worth, not a to-infinitive.
examples: Incorrect: The proposal is worth to consider.

rules.zh: 在 This book is worth reading 中，book 是接受 reading 動作的一方；這個常用結構仍使用主動 V-ing，而非 being read。
rules.en: The subject often receives the V-ing action. In This book is worth reading, the book does not perform the reading; nevertheless, the common structure uses active V-ing rather than being read.
examples: It is worth reading this book.

rules.zh: V-ing 片語可保留受詞、副詞和其他補語。
rules.en: Keep the object, adverb or other details after V-ing when they are part of the action being judged.
examples: The plan is worth discussing with the whole team.
The report is worth reading carefully.

rules.zh: worth 可以直接接金額，金額前不要加 of；a value of 是另一個名詞結構。
rules.en: Worth can be followed directly by an amount of money. Do not add of; a value of is a separate noun structure.
examples: Incorrect: The watch is worth of £200.

rules.zh: worth it 可代表之前提及的價錢、努力、等待或困難，但只是可選延伸，不是本課主要目標。
rules.en: Worth it is an optional extension when it represents a previously mentioned cost, effort, wait or difficulty; it is not the main target of this exercise.
examples: The journey was tiring, but it was worth it.

rules.zh: worthwhile 是另一個字，使用不同文法；題目可出現，但答案須改用 be worth + noun ／ V-ing。
rules.en: Worthwhile is a separate word with different grammar. It may appear in a source prompt, but required answers use be worth + noun / V-ing.
examples: A visit to the museum would be worthwhile.

rules.zh: worthy of 是另一個正確但不同的結構；本課答案改寫為 be worth + V-ing。
rules.en: Worthy of is another grammatical but separate structure. This exercise rewrites it with be worth + V-ing.
examples: The proposal is worthy of consideration.

benefits.zh: 說明一件事的好處是否足以抵償所需價錢、時間、努力或困難。
benefits.en: It helps judge whether something gives enough value to justify its price, time, effort or difficulty.

benefits.zh: 不直接命令對方，也能以較溫和的判斷提出建議並保留對方的選擇。
benefits.en: It gives recommendations without sounding like an order by offering a softer judgement and leaving the final choice to the listener.

benefits.zh: 清楚比較可能好處與金錢、時間、不便或風險。
benefits.en: It makes cost-and-benefit comparisons clear by showing what benefit is being weighed against money, time, inconvenience or risk.

benefits.zh: 用 be worth 縮短『善用時間』或『好處足以抵償努力』等較長解釋。
benefits.en: It shortens a longer explanation about whether an action is a good use of time or whether its benefits justify the effort.

benefits.zh: 同一核心結構可描述值得進行的行動、值得注意的事物、值得承受的成本或風險，以及物品的金錢價值。
benefits.en: It works for actions, objects and monetary value, including actions worth performing, matters worth attention, costs or risks worth accepting and an item’s price.

benefits.zh: Is it worth doing? 等問題鼓勵比較利弊，適合討論、作文、評論、報告和日常決策。
benefits.en: It helps discuss decisions rather than give simple opinions, making it useful in discussions, essays, reviews, reports and everyday choices.
